title: technical-research: P0 research subskill 6/9 + control 23 (R04 grounded options, earned)
objective: Build the technical-research subskill: a concise SKILL.md that yields candidate engineering approaches (an option set, not one early answer) grounded in the record's evidence, and does not rank/choose. Add control 23 (earned by failing-first): an R04 (TECHNICAL_SOLUTION) record carries at least one alternative, and every alternative's evidence_refs resolves to a claim, finding or source in the record. Register IMPLEMENTED; badf-research stays DESIGNED (6 of 9 P0).
business_value: technical-research widens the option space honestly before a choice is made; grounding each candidate in gathered evidence stops an approach from being asserted, and requiring a technical-solution run to yield options stops it from concluding with nothing.
